top3.why: Both starting CBs DNP Monday (calf, knee). On a short week, missing both would gut IND's pass defense vs. Stroud/Dell — supports HOU -9.5 and the Over.
Starting LT in concussion protocol with 3 days to clear; backup T Travis also DNP (knee). Exposes IND QB to HOU pass rush — though HOU's Danielle Hunter is DNP too.

top3.player: Danielle Hunter / Azeez Al-Shaair / Marvin Harrison Jr.
top3.why: Top edge rusher, top LB and a starting WR all DNP Monday. If Hunter and Al-Shaair sit, HOU's defense softens — the main path to IND covering +9.5.

HOU front seven: Danielle Hunter (DNP), Azeez Al-Shaair (DNP), Jake Hummel (LP)
